title: Longest substring without repeating characters
statement:
Return the length of the longest substring of s with no repeated character.

Constraints: up to 5 × 10⁴ characters (letters, digits, symbols, spaces).
hints: Grow a window to the right; when a character repeats, the window's left edge must jump past its previous occurrence.
Remember each character's last index. Careful with "abba": never move the left edge backwards.

solution.explanation: A window [start, i] with distinct characters. On seeing c, if its last occurrence is inside the window, move start just past it (only forward: last[c] >= start). Update the best length each step. Each index enters and leaves the window once: O(n).
